title: Outward Flux of a Radial Vector Field Across a Circle
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the outward flux of F = <x, y> across the circle r(t) = <3 cos(t), 3 sin(t)> for 0 <= t <= 2*pi.

steps.title: Recall Planar Flux Formula
steps.explanation: Formula for flux across counterclockwise curve.

steps.title: Substitute Circular Parametrization
steps.mathExpression: x = 3\cos t, \; y = 3\sin t \implies dx = -3\sin t \, dt, \; dy = 3\cos t \, dt

steps.title: Evaluate Flux Integral
steps.mathExpression: M \, dy - N \, dx = (3\cos t)(3\cos t \, dt) - (3\sin t)(-3\sin t \, dt) = 9(\cos^2 t + \sin^2 t) \, dt = 9 \, dt; \quad \text{Flux} = \int_0^{2\pi} 9 \, dt = 18\pi
